en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1236 - Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj narrated from Imam Abu al-Hasan (as) regarding a man who prayed in congregation on Jumu’ah.

When the Imam bowed, the crowd pushed him against a wall or pillar, preventing him from bowing or prostrating until the people raised their heads. He asked if he should bow, then prostrate, and catch up with the row when the people stand, or what he should do.
Imam (as) replied: "He should bow and prostrate, then stand with the row, and there is no issue with that."
